identity.title: No API key commit and push guard

authorization.reference: Remove the API keys from the GitHub repository, create a repository rule that checks for API keys before commit and push, then continue work.

blockers: GitHub cached commit views can only be garbage-collected by GitHub Support even after all branch references are clean.
Google-side key rotation or revocation is outside repository access and remains Operator-owned.
lifecycle.next_action: Run staged and pre-push counterfactuals, complete adversarial subagent review, remediate findings, and run canonical gates before committing and pushing.

scope.summary: Purge exposed Google-key strings from reachable GitHub history and enforce exact staged, outgoing-history, canonical verification, and remote push-protection checks without a new runtime dependency.
in_scope: Sanitize all affected GitHub branch histories and verify from a fresh remote mirror.
Add a provider-pattern scanner to the existing pinned Rust xtask.
Install repository-owned pre-commit and pre-push hooks.
Add canonical authority, topology, registry, taskboard, and verify-pr integration.
Attack the implementation through independent adversarial review.
non_goals: Google Cloud credential rotation or revocation.
New Python, Go, Docker, hosted scanner, runtime, or native dependency.
A universal proof that every arbitrary secret format is absent.
Any Ferric product capability or runtime-progress claim.
dependencies: Pinned repository Rust toolchain and existing fforager-xtask dependencies.
Supported-host Git executable already governed by build/tooling-policy.toml.
GitHub secret scanning and push protection enabled for Nuntissura/ferric_forager.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Every GitHub branch and tag is rewritten where necessary, and a fresh remote mirror scan observes zero Google API-key pattern matches across all reachable commits.
evidence: Fresh mirror of 11 remote branches and 120 reachable commits reported GoogleKeyMatches=0 and git fsck --full exit 0; no tags, pull requests, or forks exist.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Pre-commit scans exact stage-zero Git index blobs, rejects a provider-pattern key, accepts the explicit redacted placeholder, scans binary bytes, and never emits the matched value.
evidence: Five focused secret_scan tests passed, including staged rejection, clean placeholder, binary scanning, history rejection, and diagnostic suppression.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Pre-push consumes Git's update rows and scans every complete outgoing commit tree, including all ancestry for a new branch, while deletions remain legal.
The idempotent hook installer sets core.hooksPath to build/git-hooks and both committed hooks invoke FF-GATE-SECRET-001 before commit and push.
Project authority carries stable no-key rule and gate IDs; START_HERE requires hook installation; verify-pr scans reachable history, exact index, and tracked or non-ignored worktree files.
Formatting, warnings-denied Clippy, focused and full tests, architecture-check, verify-pr, governance parsing, registry checks, allowed-path containment, and real secret-scan commands pass.
GitHub secret scanning and push protection remain enabled as an independent remote pre-receive control, with unavailable optional modes reported truthfully.
evidence: GitHub repository API reports secret_scanning=enabled and secret_scanning_push_protection=enabled; non-provider patterns and validity checks remained disabled after an enable attempt.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: No new external executable, package, native dependency, or product runtime behavior is added; the packet claims zero product progress.

checks_run: Fresh remote mirror scan: 120 commits, zero Google-key matches, git fsck exit 0.
blockers: GitHub Support is required for server-side garbage collection of cached old commit views.
Google-side credential rotation or revocation is unavailable from repository access.
last_checkpoint.next_action: Run exact staged and simulated outgoing-push counterfactuals, then independent adversarial reviews.

not_proven: Absence of every unknown or unstructured credential format.
Removal from other people's already-created clones.
GitHub cached old-SHA views before GitHub Support garbage collection.

required_outcomes: Remote reachable history contains no Google API key pattern.
Every exact staged snapshot and outgoing commit is scanned before commit or push.
Matched values are suppressed and GitHub pre-receive protection remains enabled.

reuse_candidates_in_order_with_result.candidate: no mechanism beyond the accepted outcome
reuse_candidates_in_order_with_result.result: Rejected because the reported exposure proves an enforceable commit and push boundary is required.
Selected: extend the existing pinned fforager-xtask and verify-pr aggregation.
Selected for bounded byte scanning, Git process control, deterministic parsing, and tests.
Selected: Git hooks and exact Git object plumbing supply the local snapshot boundaries.
Selected only for existing xtask dependencies; no additional dependency is needed.
Selected as one Rust module, two hooks, authority bindings, and independent GitHub push protection.

artifact_specific_justification.secret-scan-module: Owns bounded provider-pattern scanning and exact Git snapshot traversal without a new dependency.
artifact_specific_justification.pre-commit-hook: Invokes the scanner against exact stage-zero index blobs before Git creates a commit.
artifact_specific_justification.pre-push-hook: Invokes the scanner against every outgoing complete commit snapshot before network transfer.
artifact_specific_justification.authority-bindings: Make installation, execution boundaries, and no-key behavior durable project rules.
artifact_specific_justification.work-packet: Records the high-risk rewrite, residual cache limitation, validation, and sanitized migration state.

change_evidence.pre_simplification_verdict: FAIL: reachable GitHub history contained three Google API-key strings and the repository had no mandatory before-commit or before-push credential gate.
simplification_changes: Reused the existing Rust xtask and Git rather than introducing Python, Go, Docker, a hosted service, or a new package.
Deduplicated history scanning by Git blob object ID while retaining complete commit-tree coverage.
Kept diagnostics to provider pattern ID, source identity, and line without retaining or printing secret values.
change_evidence.post_simplification_verdict: PASS: the current implementation closes the direct exposed-key and local hook gaps with no new dependency, while retaining explicit limits for unknown secret formats and GitHub cache garbage collection.
complete_post_change_verification: Fresh GitHub mirror scan reports zero Google-key matches across every reachable commit.
Focused staged, history, binary, placeholder, and diagnostic-suppression tests pass.
Hook installer and verifier report build/git-hooks.
GitHub API reports secret scanning and push protection enabled.

ceilings_exceptions_and_evidence.current_ceiling: Provider-prefix matching and GitHub provider scanning cannot prove absence of every unknown or unstructured secret format.
ceilings_exceptions_and_evidence.replacement_trigger: A missed credential format, material false-positive burden, new approved scanner dependency, or GitHub custom-pattern availability.
ceilings_exceptions_and_evidence.likely_upgrade_path: Adopt a pinned mature scanner or approved custom pattern set while preserving exact staged, outgoing-history, value-suppression, and remote pre-receive contracts.
ceilings_exceptions_and_evidence.trigger_detection_method: Secret-scanning alerts, incident review, mutation fixtures, provider-format changes, and periodic scanner coverage review.
